name: Tacoronte (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, green and yellow with a double-width green stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Tacoronte (the word TAGORO above crossed tools on red).
history: The municipal flag was approved by the Government of the Canary Islands on 26 September 2011; it is rectangular with three stripes perpendicular to the hoist. The municipality also has a square maroon standard approved on 1 March 2011.

features.role: Tacoronte arms — the word TAGORO above crossed tools on red
